differences.justification: ManagedHsmSkuName changed from a closed enum to an ExpandableStringEnum in API version 2026-05-15 so that new Managed HSM SKUs can be added without a breaking change. Approved by the Azure Breaking Changes Board.
ManagedHsmSkuName changed from a closed enum to an ExpandableStringEnum, so the interfaces implicitly implemented by java.lang.Enum (Comparable, Serializable, Constable) are no longer implemented.
ManagedHsmSkuName now extends ExpandableStringEnum, which is supplied by azure-core rather than by this archive.
ExpandableStringEnum requires a public no-argument constructor; the former enum constructor was implicitly private.

ManagedHsmSkuName changed from a closed enum to an ExpandableStringEnum, so the enum-specific members (values, valueOf, name, ordinal, compareTo, getDeclaringClass, describeConstable) are no longer present. Use ManagedHsmSkuName.fromString(String) and ManagedHsmSkuName.values() instead.
ExpandableStringEnum.values() returns a Collection rather than an array.
